english.title: Driver of m/vehicle fail to give own / owner name / address / produce insurance/ test cert after road accident / offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person

(A)_[driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have been the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), at a time when an accident occurred owing to its presence,]_
(C)_[whom a constable had reasonable cause to believe to have committed an offence in relation to the use of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

on a road namely, **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to give your name and address and the name and address of the owner of the vehicle and to produce for examination the relevant certificate of insurance or security under Part VI of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and a test certificate issued in respect of the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to section 165(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to motor vehicles other than invalid carriages.
(ii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See sections 165(2)(c) for requirements re production of goods vehicle plating certificate and test certificate
(iv) From 1st November 2019, the Motor Vehicles (Compulsory Insurance) (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/1047) removed the current securities regime, which was used as an alternative to conventional motor insurance. A two-year transitional period applied to existing securities and deposits; this meant that new securities could not be issued, however, it did not prevent individuals renewing current securities - as long as they were valid until 1st November 2021. From 1st November 2021 compulsory motor insurance is required. See offence H100101.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was

(A)_[the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[suspected of being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) when an accident occurred owing its presence]_
(C)_[suspected of committing an offence in relation to the use of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_

on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). the defendant failed to give

(D)_[his name and address and the name and address of the vehicle's owner]_
(E)_[her name and address and the name and address of the vehicle's owner]_

to a police constable when requested to do so and failed to produce for examination a relevant insurance certificate and a test certificate in respect of the vehicle, when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.
